environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (m5.large, 2 vCPU) running Amazon Linux 2. No request timeout configured at any layer. The service is exposed directly via an Elastic IP on port 8080 with a security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on TCP/8080. The PostgreSQL RDS instance has RLS policies configured but the application connects using a role that has BYPASSRLS privilege (the 'app' role was granted rds_superuser during initial setup for migration convenience and never revoked). No rate limiting, no WAF, no reverse proxy. The regex crate version is 1.7.0.
